items.title: Fungal disease threatens rice harvest in Palpa
items.desc: Farmers report yield losses of 15 to 20 percent as the disease spreads through paddy fields, with symptoms appearing after the plants develop panicles.

items.title: Nepal says it is saddened by the killing of its citizen in Saudi oil field attack
items.desc: The Foreign Ministry said Nepal reiterates its unequivocal condemnation of all attacks targeted at civilians and critical infrastructure.

items.title: Pakistan all-rounder Hussain Talat joins Karnali Yaks
items.desc: The 30-year-old, who has represented Pakistan in ODIs and T20 internationals, brings franchise experience from the PSL and BPL to the Nepal Premier League.

items.title: Madhyapur Thimi celebrates its Malla-era battle tradition
items.desc: Observed annually on the 11th day of Dashain, the ‘Kha: Pihanwaigu’ festival features a procession with traditional weapons and ceremonial armour, followed by a ritual believed to protect households from illness.

items.title: Deepa Nepali’s 186-day protest goes unheard as government stays silent
items.desc: The activist spent Dashain at Maitighar Mandala, demanding action against caste-based discrimination and the exclusion of Dalits from rented accommodation.

items.title: A Nepali among eight injured in Dammam airport attack
items.desc: The airport attack came hours after falling debris from a drone intercepted by Saudi air defences near a processing facility at Aramco’s Shaybah oil field killed a Nepali and a Filipino worker and injured two others.

items.title: What is PHP, and why are security flaws putting European government websites at risk?
items.desc: Two critical flaws could let hackers take control of vulnerable servers, prompting warnings to patch systems or take websites offline.

items.title: Scrub typhus death toll reaches ten in Salyan
items.desc: The district has recorded 817 infections, with Darma Rural Municipality reporting the highest number of cases.

items.title: Kathmandu to host Cricket World Cup Qualifier Play-Off in December
items.desc: Eight teams will compete for four places in the 2027 ICC Men’s Cricket World Cup Qualifier, with Nepal, the UAE, Namibia and Canada among the participants.

items.title: Two killed in motorcycle crash in Arghakhanchi
items.desc: The motorcycle crashed in Bhumikasthan Municipality-2 on Wednesday night, killing the father and son at the scene.

items.title: ICC recognises Nepal Premier League matches as List A T20 fixtures
items.desc: The recognition means performances in the October 26-November 21 tournament will count towards official T20 statistics.

items.title: Putin agrees to resume 3-way peace talks with Ukraine and US
items.desc: The Kremlin says the next round of US-mediated talks could begin in November, but Moscow and Kyiv remain far apart on territorial concessions, security guarantees and the terms of a peace deal.

items.title: After Nepal’s recent disaster, it wants to test whether COP31 can deliver climate justice
items.desc: Nepal has made an emergency appeal to the UN’s loss-and-damage fund, which has yet to disburse any money. Meanwhile, families wait for relief, and the country takes on more loans to rebuild.

items.title: Nepali worker killed in drone attack on Saudi Aramco oil field
items.desc: A Filipino national was also killed, while a Pakistani and an Indian worker were injured, Saudi Arabia’s energy ministry says.

items.title: Dashain just isn’t the same in this village anymore
items.desc: In Dadeldhura’s Kafali, families have dwindled from 17 to six as people leave in search of better services and livelihoods, leaving behind empty homes and fading festival traditions.

items.title: Nepal to host 15 matches at 2027 Under-19 Women’s T20 World Cup
items.desc: The 16-team tournament will run for 17 days, with Kathmandu hosting Nepal’s group-stage matches against Ireland, India and West Indies.

items.title: How cheap Chinese antibiotics threaten Europe's last major penicillin plant
items.desc: Cheap Chinese supplies threaten Europe’s last penicillin plant, raising fears of drug shortages and dependence on imports.

items.title: Foreign tourists join Dashain celebrations in Thamel
items.desc: Visitors at a Kathmandu hotel receive tika and jamara on Bijaya Dashami, embracing one of Nepal’s biggest festivals and its cultural traditions.

items.title: Five detained for allegedly allowing Nepalis to gamble at Parsa casino
items.desc: Nepali law bars citizens from entering casinos and gambling, but police say the facility was allowing them to do so.

items.title: Even on Dashain, some Nepalis leave their families behind in search of a better future abroad
items.desc: After celebrating the festival with loved ones, migrant workers head to the airport with tika and jamara on their foreheads, bound for jobs and opportunities overseas.

items.title: Former president Bidya Devi Bhandari to leave for China on Thursday
items.desc: Her trip to a global governance forum will be her first overseas visit since her nomination as a senior CPN-UML leader.

items.title: President Paudel receives Dashain tika at Sheetal Niwas
items.desc: Ramchandra Paudel received tika, jamara and religious offerings from his priest at 10:26am before blessing his wife and other family members.

items.title: Dashain’s sacred jamara draws buyers in Kathmandu
items.desc: Crowds gather in the Kasthamandap area to buy bundles of jamara, placed on people’s heads as a blessing during Vijaya Dashami.

items.title: Dashain should inspire fight against corruption, poor governance, says PM Shah
items.desc: In his Vijaya Dashami message, Balendra Shah calls for collective action to end bureaucratic delays, inequality and political distortions and restore public trust in government.

items.title: Bird strike disrupts flights at Kathmandu airport
items.desc: A pigeon struck a Turkish Airlines aircraft during landing, damaging a nose landing gear light and delaying flight operations while the runway was cleared.

items.title: Dashain takes me back to the child I once was
items.desc: From village gatherings and tika from grandparents to the struggles of celebrating away from home, the festival remains a reminder of childhood joys and the family bonds that endure.

items.title: For some in Kathmandu, Dashain is just another day
items.desc: Unable to afford the journey home or even new clothes for their children, daily-wage earners struggle to find joy in Nepal’s biggest festival.
